title: Add the pair-version guard when quest first wires a lore invocation (DEC-31: lore validation error, lore sentence, at the spawn)
description:
DEC-31 option A, accepted by the operator first-party via opum-doc (relay R-2026-09-29-12): the runtime half of the lore/quest exact pair-version lock is a CONTRACT ONLY for now, because quest has no lore invocation to hook. This task carries that contract so the first change that wires one cannot miss it.

TRIGGER: the first change in quest-cli that invokes the lore binary. Today there are ZERO reachable lore invocations: scrubbing all 83 TypeScript files in src/ for process spawns finds seven sites (three git, one agent-runtime CLI set, one argv runner in the jira importer) and exactly two lore spawns -- src/adapters/lore/lore-cli.ts (export --json) and src/adapters/lore/backlog-cli.ts via a runner defaulting to "lore" -- whose ONLY importers in the repository are two integration tests, so no shipped command reaches either. The live seam runs the other way: the lore check CI job puts this checkout quest on PATH and runs lore against it (lore-cli side, where its quest adapter carries a MIN_QUEST_VERSION floor).

WHAT THE GUARD MUST BE, in DEC-31 own terms, which supersede the OPAG-748 proposal wording so the pair reads as ONE contract: the check goes immediately before that spawn; it fails with LORE error type -- validation, exit 6 (not the drift the proposal suggested); and it uses lore sentence shape, "the lore X / quest Y pair version requirement is not met: ...", naming both installed versions and the side that is behind. Compared on the FULL version. Where quest invokes lore is the ONLY place quest checks lore.

WHY NO CODE NOW: building the guard today means dead code in unwired adapters that can rot before first use, and it would leave the actually-live seam (lore invoking quest) unguarded while looking guarded. The operator took that over the implement-now alternative.

The broader pairing gap -- the release lockstep being unenforced contract -- stays QCLI-293; this task is the runtime half only.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Before the first lore invocation lands in quest-cli, the guard is in place immediately before the spawn: a full-version comparison that fails with error type validation (exit 6) and lore sentence shape naming both installed versions and the side that is behind. It fails closed -- no silent pass when the comparison cannot be made.

The guard covers every lore invocation site this repository has at the time, enumerated by sweeping src/ for process spawns rather than by trusting the list above, which was measured 2026-09-29 and names two unwired adapters.
